description.zh: 邮寄地址ID，对应QueryCustomerAddressList接口返回的ID参数。
description.en: The mailing address ID. This ID corresponds to the `ID` parameter returned by the `QueryCustomerAddressList` operation.

description.zh: 申请人昵称，系统不做校验。
description.en: The applicant nickname. The system does not verify this value.

description.zh: 发票抬头信息ID，对应QueryInvoicingCustomerList接口返回的ID参数。
description.en: The invoicing customer ID. This ID corresponds to the `ID` parameter returned by the `QueryInvoicingCustomerList` operation.

description.zh: 是否按金额开票，若为true则按照用户指定InvoiceAmount申请发票，否则以所选待开票对象的总金额申请发票。
description.en: Specifies whether to create an invoice for a specific amount. If you set this parameter to `true`, an invoice is created for the amount specified in the `InvoiceAmount` parameter. If you set this parameter to `false`, an invoice is created for the total amount of the items specified in the `SelectedIds` parameter.

description.zh:
发票类型，取值：
- 0：专票
- 1：普票
description.en:
The invoice type. Valid values:

- 0: special invoice

- 1: general invoice

description.zh:
开票渠道，要求为1。取值示例：
- 0：阿里云处理
- 1：税务平台处理
description.en:
The invoicing channel. This parameter must be set to 1. The following list describes the channel types:

- 0: Processed by Alibaba Cloud (Not applicable to this operation)

- 1: Processed by the tax platform

description.zh: 选择开票的待开票对象ID列表，对应QueryEvaluateList接口返回的ID参数。
description.en: The IDs of the items to be invoiced. These IDs correspond to the `ID` parameter returned by the `QueryEvaluateList` operation.

description.zh: 发票接收邮箱。字段长度最长200，多个邮箱可用英文逗号分隔
description.en: The email addresses of the invoice recipient. To specify multiple addresses, separate them with commas (,). The value cannot exceed 200 characters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi apply-invoice --invoice-amount 10000 --customer-id 124132423 --address-id 237958367 --invoicing-type 1 --process-way 1 --apply-user-nick test --invoice-by-amount true --user-remark test --selected-ids 384752367 --emails aaa@aa.com,bbb@bb.com --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi ApplyInvoice --region cn-hangzhou --InvoiceByAmount true --emails 'aaa@aa.com,bbb@bb.com' --SelectedIds.1 384752367 --InvoicingType 1 --UserRemark test --ApplyUserNick test --InvoiceAmount 10000 --CustomerId 124132423 --ProcessWay 1 --AddressId 237958367
